title: Implement A2: Fix ritual-history persistence and fully activate backend-driven Insights + badge milestones

requirements.text: Implement real backend computation for `getInsightsData()` so Insights no longer returns placeholder/zero values and correctly reflects the couple’s post-deploy ritual activity.

quotes: Great! Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getInsightsData()` returns non-placeholder values derived from stored data (not hard-coded zeros/empty arrays).
After both partners submit today’s ritual, `getInsightsData().currentStreak` becomes >= 1 and `last14DayTrend` includes `true` for today.
`last14DayTrend` and `last30DayTrend` are deterministic arrays representing day-by-day completion-by-both (lengths 14 and 30 respectively) ending at the current day.
`harmonyTrend` is deterministic and aligned with the returned day-trend series (suitable for the frontend’s last-7 slicing).

requirements.text: Fix streak and completion calculations to be order-stable and couple-based, counting a day as complete only when both partners have submitted a ritual response for that day.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: Current streak and longest streak are computed from day numbers in chronological order (no dependence on Map iteration order).
A day with only one partner response does not increment streak and is represented as missed in trend arrays.
If the second partner completes later the same day, the day flips from missed/incomplete to complete without creating duplicate day entries.

requirements.text: Compute and return harmony metrics from real stored data: quiz alignment (from both partners’ saved Love Languages quiz results) + recent ritual consistency (from recent completion trends), and expose them via `quizOverlapScore`, `recentCompletionRate`, `currentHarmony`, and `averageHarmony`.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: When both partners have quiz results saved, `quizOverlapScore` is non-zero and reflects overlap of each partner’s top rankings (backend-driven).
`recentCompletionRate` reflects completion-by-both over the recent window used by Insights (expressed as 0..1 Float).
`currentHarmony` and `averageHarmony` are computed from (quiz alignment + recent completion) and are returned as 0..1 Float values.
If either partner has not completed the quiz, `quizOverlapScore` falls back to 0 without trapping, and other metrics still compute from ritual consistency alone.

requirements.text: Replace `getBadgeMilestones()` default milestone logic with real computed milestone progress (7/30/100 day streaks and harmony elite) derived from the same computations used by `getInsightsData()`.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: `getBadgeMilestones().milestones` reflects real unlocked state for: sevenDayUnlocked, thirtyDayUnlocked, hundredDayUnlocked, harmonyEliteUnlocked.
After crossing a threshold (e.g., reaching a 7-day streak), the corresponding milestone boolean becomes true for both partners in the couple.
`getBadgeMilestones()` no longer returns `getDefaultMilestoneProgress()` except as a fallback when the caller is unpaired/unauthorized (and must follow existing authorization rules).

requirements.text: Ensure ritual submission writes/maintains the canonical daily history used by Insights so that a successful “both completed today” state is reflected consistently across Home, Ritual History, and Insights.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: After both partners submit the daily ritual, `getRitualHistory(7)` includes an entry for today with two responses, and `getInsightsData()` shows today as completed.
Submitting the second partner response updates the same day entry rather than creating multiple entries for the same day.
Ritual entries remain accessible via existing access-control rules (only self/partner/admin as currently enforced by the canister).

requirements.text: Add lightweight diagnostic logging around ritual submission and daily completion resolution to aid debugging without breaking queries or leaking sensitive content.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: On `submitRitualResponse`, the backend emits minimal logs indicating: caller principal, coupleId, day number, and whether the day is now complete-by-both (do not log ritual text, emoji, or photos).
Logs do not cause traps and do not change API response shapes.

requirements.text: Update frontend data expectations only where needed to display the newly-real backend Insights values (no UI redesign), ensuring the Insights screen updates after ritual submission without requiring a hard reload.

quotes: Please proceed with implementing the updated A2 plan.

acceptanceCriteria: After completing a ritual from both accounts, the Insights page shows non-zero streak and a 7-day history row for Today marked Done (not Missed) once polling/refetch completes.
Milestone badges reflect backend milestone booleans (unlock when backend says unlocked).
No changes are made to immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not introduce third-party auth providers; Internet Identity remains the only auth mechanism.
nonGoals: Implementing new product features outside A2 (e.g., new tabs, new ritual types, push notifications, external analytics).
Changing the overall UI theme/layout of the Insights page beyond wiring it to real backend values.
Adding a new database or external storage layer.
